description: OHLCV candles for one token by chain slug and contract address. `tf` sets the resolution; `from`/`to` are unix SECONDS. Always pass tf and from: with no window the answer runs to over a thousand bars. Use a coarse tf (60, 1D) for long windows.

address.description: Token contract address (0x… on EVM, base58 mint on Solana).

chain.description: Chain slug, e.g. ethereum, base, solana, robinhood.

name: get_token_candles
title: Get token candles
